Alyssa: Quick sync — need to prioritize onboarding 'cinder-70b' for the signal sprint. TL;DR: HF weights latency looks okay but 4-bit quant shows quality drop on summarization and codebench.
Ravi: Can you paste the scorecard? numbers help.
Alyssa: Sure — short paste (local eval, batch=8, seq=512):
```
Task         | FP16  | Q4_0
ROUGE-L      | 42.3  | 38.7
Code Exact   | 67.1  | 59.8
Instruction  | 78.0  | 74.2
Latency p95  | 180ms | 145ms
```
Marta: Oof, 3.6 ROUGE drop. Product asked for cinder for abstractive summarization roadmap. If we can't hit quality target, we should consider 34b alternate or a mixed-routing plan.
Sam: Infra note: dedicated pool for 70b available week of 4/4 but limited. If we keep FP16 for canary and Q4_0 for cold path we could do canary traffic. Also: need quantized kernel tweaks — I'll pair with Eng-ML.
deploy-bot: canary-slot reserved: canary-71 for 2023-04-06 03:00 UTC.
Ravi: Proposal: prioritize as Medium-High if product OK with mixed routing. Owner: Alyssa.
Steps:
- small eval: add per-layer calibration (Alyssa) by 2023-03-29
- infra plan: canary pool + fallback policy (Sam) by 2023-04-02
- UX check with product (Marta) by 2023-03-31
Alyssa: I'll make the intake doc and update the model gate scorecard (quality delta, cost delta, infra risk). Will ping when PR is up. :thumbsup:
Marta: Can someone run a quick eval on 50 summarization holdouts with prompt-temperature sweep? tag me when results are in. :eyes: 
Sam: Reserving infra slot and adding autoscaling floor. Will post details in the infra-ops ticket.
Alyssa: Assigning owners: Alyssa (evals), Sam (infra), Marta (product). Target: canary readiness 2023-04-06. Thanks!
